input: I work at Mr. E.N. van Kleffensstraat 8 in Arnhem. What year was this building built? What's the energy label and floor area? Answer with only a JSON object with the keys "year_built", "energy_label" and "floor_area_m2".

metadata.hypothesis: The answer needs two registrations: the BAG for the building year and floor area, EP-Online for the energy label. A model without tools can only guess. EP-Online shows a label only after a POST of its search form, which a fetch by GET cannot do, but sites such as kadastralekaart.com republish both registrations and turn up in web search, so source stays 0 even when the answer is right
